designationHistory.indexText: Name changed from Sanford National Recreation Area to Lake Meredith Recreation Area Oct. 16, 1972

sources.name: The National Parks: Index 2012–2016 (National Park Service), PDF page 100

review.note: The 1973 NPS master plan confirms the change from Sanford Recreation Area to Lake Meredith Recreation Area but gives no date. No act or Federal Register notice of Oct. 16, 1972 was found (Statutes at Large; Federal Register issues Oct. 1 - Nov. 19, 1972 searched). The date rests on the Index alone.
